## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: strong sector breadth alongside sizable Tech weakness (multiple mega-cap Tech names BELOW TREND) and simultaneous strength in Energy/Utilities/Real Estate — mixed signals supporting CAUTION.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +6.87% | 1M: +2.38%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -4.44%) RECOVERY. Energy strong: EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +0.06% | 1M: +16.78%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate: EQIX (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +15.27%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.30% | 1M: +0.94%) CORRECTION. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -2.24%) BELOW TREND. Communication negative overall with TTWO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -17.08%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND; EL (1W: +10.16% | 1M: -3.00%) RECOVERY; EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -4.44%) RECOVERY; AZN (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +9.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TTWO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -17.08%) BELOW TREND; DOW (1W: -6.01% | 1M: +14.54%) CORRECTION; EMR (1W: -6.17% | 1M: +1.51%) CORRECTION; AMD (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -13.68%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -21.87%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Professional Services names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Largest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.16% | 1M: -3.00%) RECOVERY, EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, NVDA, META, UNH, EL etc. show 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical volatility likely, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, tilt to weakness. AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND provide pockets of strength, while MSFT (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND and IBM (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND show meaningful weakness; sector 1W: -2.37% (Technology under pressure).

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak. AIG (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +9.41%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while JPM (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -2.24%) BELOW TREND point to softness; sector 1W: -2.15% (Financials lagging overall).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive but selective. AZN (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +9.18%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND anchor strength while LLY (1W: -0.27% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND and UNH (1W: +5.48% | 1M: -12.94%) RECOVERY show mixed internals; sector 1W: +1.46% (Healthcare holding up).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy/Utilities/Real Estate and select Industrials (EOG, XOM, CAT) while reducing exposure to the weakest mega-cap Tech names showing BELOW TREND (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, ACN). Style: Value/Cyclical bias given sector leadership and broad top-performer dispersion; CAUTION flags require tighter risk controls and monitoring of major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND, AZN (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +9.18%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: IBM (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -17.08%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +1.98%) and Utilities (1W: +3.56%) — monitor continuation of flows. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.37%) and Financials (1W: -2.15%) — watch for further downside or stabilization.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -0.30% | 1M: +0.94%) CORRECTION — watch for a sustained 1W positive close to confirm a recovery attempt. AAPL (1W: -3.41% | 1M: +3.55%) CORRECTION — failure to regain 1M trend would expand downside risk. JPM (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND — a weekly reclaim of prior support would signal stabilization. EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND — continuation on volume confirms cyclical leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+65): Nvidia (1W: -0.30% | 1M: +0.94%) CORRECTION — bullish AI chip headlines but price slightly soft (sentiment > price = divergence). LLY (+55): Eli Lilly (1W: -0.27% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND — positive trial coverage contrasts with flat/soft price (divergence). AAPL (+55): Apple (1W: -3.41% | 1M: +3.55%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines but short-term weakness (watch for confirmation).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
IBM (-75): IBM (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirmed by steep price falls. META (-50): Meta (1W: -4.10% | 1M: +3.70%) CORRECTION — legal headlines add downside risk while price shows short-term pullback. TMUS (-50): T-Mobile (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +14.45%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price strong (sentiment/price divergence; monitor for follow-through).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy/Utilities/Real Estate leadership and mixed Tech internals. EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND and EQIX (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +15.27%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence between bullish news (NVDA, AAPL, LLY) and small short-term price weakness — watch for trend confirmation or escalation.
